fields.Name: IT155 - Video Generation Cost
fields.Description: Deterministic server-transport integration checks (VGC1–VGC2) for AIVideoRunner.RunGenerateVideo against Default Generative Video and FLUX 3 Video (VS-GEN-4): VGC1 proves a run reporting Seconds usage with no driver cost is priced on save by MJAIPromptRunEntityServer from the active Per Second model cost row and flushed before RunGenerateVideo returns; VGC2 proves a driver-reported cost (1.23 USD) is preserved on the saved prompt run row without recomputation and returned on the result.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: VGC1 prices 6 seconds of video output from the active Per Second cost row immediately on save; VGC2 preserves driver-reported 1.23 USD cost on both the prompt run row and the runner result.
